scope: Source-specific SQL serving assessment. No new SQL schema or production load performed by this assessment.

sources.limits: Filing status and report links, not parsed donations or campaign amounts.
sources.sqlDesign: Normalize annual filings separately from campaign finance and donor transactions. Preserve absent filing vs missing corpus; use report URL and source hash.

sources.limits: Generation in TWh; demand, imports and emissions have different units.
sources.sqlDesign: Normalize fuel observations and a separate annual system record. Negative net imports mean exports; do not sum emissions with electricity.

sources.limits: EUR/kWh, household band and taxes fixed by source dataset.
sources.sqlDesign: Retain country, period, household consumption band and tax basis; never treat this as a spot-market series. Gas needs its own band/source.

sources.limits: Four benefit families with distinct recipient nouns; amountBgn and eurRate.
sources.sqlDesign: Normalize family and annual observations. Keep household/person recipients distinct, annual vs campaign periods, national-only geography and BGN/EUR basis.

sources.limits: Nights in hotels (NACE I551), not unique tourists or arrivals.
sources.sqlDesign: Separate monthly seasonality, annual foreign nights and residence-market totals. Preserve seasonalityYear and sourceMarketsYear independently.

sources.grain: cycle × contest × round × OIK / municipality × candidate / list
sources.limits: Council vote shares, mandates and elected mayors are separate measures. The index has 289 entries; do not assume 265 unique municipal observations.
sources.sqlDesign: Normalize from contest bundles, not by flattening the index alone. Deduplicate verified municipality identity, preserve local coalition labels, canonical-party attribution and missing second rounds. Partial cycles are excluded by the current regular-cycle chat registry.

sources.limits: Mixed annual/quarterly/monthly cadence and indicator-specific units.
sources.sqlDesign: Normalize indicator metadata separately from observations. Preserve native period, seasonal adjustment, revisions and missing values. Do not interpolate or join unmatched periods.

sources.grain: election × CIK party number × income/expense component
sources.limits: Parsed campaign income and expenses in EUR exist; donor totals are not named-donor records.
sources.sqlDesign: Load all hasFinancials cycles with their CIK party dictionary; preserve monetary/non-monetary components and nested expenses. Do not substitute another cycle for an explicitly unsupported period.

sources.limits: nrg_pc_202, household 20–199 GJ, all taxes, EUR/kWh.
sources.sqlDesign: Use an explicit gas series contract retaining band and tax basis; keep separate from household electricity and wholesale gas.
